description: S45 T4 (PM1/PM16): policy.remove captures the row AND its in-force state BEFORE the boundary deletes it and returns both after — the row as it was (the evidence the CLI verb prints and forgets; policy.get can no longer return it) plus before/after in-force renderings (D14 verbatim). A real removal lands exactly one audit row (op='remove', ids-only fixed-template summary; a system-origin row's summary says PM16's choice out loud); removing an ABSENT id is {removed:false, policy:null} with no audit row and no error (DB19 — an idempotent delete is not a failure). The actor key is again nowhere: the audit row is stamped from the connection.
